$schema.description: Editor hint only; ignored by the loader.

notes.description: What the mechanism does and how to solve it, for review.

id.description: Node id, unique in the graph; wires refer to it.

observed.description: Outputs are read outside the graph (puzzle goal, quest), so unwired is fine.

shape.description: Box, sphere or capsule, relative to the graph origin.

property.description: World property to compare (absent = its default).

op.description: Comparison; lt/lte/gt/gte need a number property.

tag.description: Tag the entity must carry, e.g. "player".

element.description: fire = burning, water = wetness > 0, ice = frozen, charge = charge > 0.

items.description: One condition; every condition of a filter must hold.

filter.description: Conditions an entity must all pass.

minWeight.description: Total occupant weight (kg) needed for `active`; default 0.

id.description: Node id, unique in the graph; wires refer to it.

observed.description: Outputs are read outside the graph (puzzle goal, quest), so unwired is fine.

entity.description: Level entity id this node is bound to.

freezePoint.description: Temperature at or below which it freezes, °C.

fragile.description: Impact energy that breaks it, J.

density.description: Density, kg/m³; below 1000 it floats in water.

climbable.description: Climbing grade: none, ladder, rope, ivy (easy), rough (needs a climber), sheer (needs a tool).

liftable.description: Can be picked up and carried.

hideable.description: An actor can hide in or behind it.

transparent.description: Light and sight pass through it.

impactAbsorb.description: Fraction of impact energy it absorbs, 0 … 1.

liquid.description: A liquid: it pours, puddles and can have a water surface.

flammableGas.description: A gas that ignites (flares or explodes) when fire reaches it.

extinguishable.description: A fire or light source that water, force or an interaction puts out.

waterSurface.description: Top surface of a body of liquid: cold freezes it into walkable ice (needs a liquid material).

unstable.description: Force of one push, blast or quake that topples it, J.

suspended.description: Hangs from its support; falls when the support breaks, burns or is cut.

support.description: Entity a suspended object hangs from (0 = none); set when the level spawns.

breakable.description: A single hit at or above its toughness for that kind of hit breaks it.

blunt.description: Blunt hit energy that breaks it, J.

slash.description: Slash hit energy that breaks it, J.

pierce.description: Pierce hit energy that breaks it, J.

force.description: Force (blast, quake, boulder) energy that breaks it, J.

toughness.description: Per kind of hit, the single-hit energy that breaks a breakable object; a kind left out never does.

bashable.description: A shield bash or kick shoves it (or breaks it when breakable).

cuttable.description: Slash or pierce damage severs it.

shootable.description: Projectile impulse that fires its signal, N·s.

softAnchor.description: Rope arrows and hooks embed in it.

surfaceHardness.description: Footstep loudness and whether arrows stick (soft, medium) or ricochet (hard).

chargeActivated.description: Stored charge at which the mechanism fires.

lightActivated.description: Light level on it at which the mechanism fires.

hidden.description: Not perceivable or targetable until revealed.

trapped.description: Interacting with it triggers its trap unless disarmed first (needs a trap).

trap.description: Trap definition id a trapped object triggers.

container.description: Holds items (contents live in the e18 container component).

remains.description: Inert skeletal or corpse remains that summoning can raise.

noiseMultiplier.description: Multiplier on its wearer's noise; an actor's is the product of its equipment's.

off.description: Written when the input falls; default none.
